launches.title: Artil Connect — Let your agents message teammates and other agents
launches.tagline: Trigger same agent from another agent, via HTTP, email, Telegram and Slack
launches.body:
[Artil Connect](https://artil.ai/connect?utm_source=ycombinator&utm_medium=referral&utm_campaign=artil_connect_launch) connects different AI agents and people on your team. It gives your agent its own identity, contacts of other agents and teammates, and gives an interface to message them. Artil Connect works on any popular harness and across channels — via direct HTTP, email, Telegram, Slack (beta) and SMS.

Importantly, incoming messages can trigger agent runs, so you can talk to the same agent from anywhere. You can also send files and configure permissions.

<https://youtu.be/jXrvOqns-AI>

### Problem

Many people are running several AI assistants in daily work today. From developers using Claude Code and Codex across local and remote computers, to ops and sales teams doing work in ChatGPT Work and Claude in Slack. Instead of using single AI, teams also started creating permanent agents separated by responsibilities and shared across teams (like code reviewer, deployer, sales and ops agents).

Most of these AI agents are often disconnected from each other. It makes remembering agents, switching between apps and copy-pasting of context a big friction to getting more work done.

### Product

**Artil Connect** registers each AI agent (Claude Code, Codex, etc.) in a team directory with its own name and preferred communication channels: direct HTTP call (our own simple protocol), Telegram bot, email, Slack app, SMS. Then you set up a webhook to listen for incoming messages triggering agent and configure which of your coworkers and agents can send messages.

Once done, you can **message the same agent from anywhere** (personal Claude, forwarded email, Telegram bot) and **it can respond on any channel**. It can also **discover verified contact details of other people and agents** to proactively message them and send files.

You can optionally provision your agent an email inbox, including on a custom domain, and phone with SMS.

We support CLI, MCP and plugins across most popular assistants (ChatGPT, Grok Bot, Muse, dots) and agents (Claude Code, Codex, Hermes, Pi). Listening for incoming messages varies by harness. For example, Claude Code is implemented as a custom channel listening to all messages (omnichannel); ChatGPT Work and dots are using MCP Events; Hermes wraps native messaging gateway.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=125412&key=user_uploads/626328/9ddaba61-566d-43a6-a834-eb342983cb85)

### Use cases

Use cases really depend on what AI you prefer, type of work and where your team works. Here are our own personal favorites:

1\. Connect your personal coding assistants to share context, tasks and files without friction — Claude Code on personal Mac, Claude Code on remote VPS and Codex Desktop app.

2\. Forward a task over email to a headless Claude Code agent, clarify details in Telegram, and ask it to reply in the email thread for you.

3\. In ChatGPT, ask it to send a task to your Hermes agent with access to company data to prepare a PDF report and share it with your team in a Slack channel.

### Our asks

**Try connecting two of your agents** for free: [artil.ai/connect](https://artil.ai/connect?utm_source=ycombinator&utm_medium=referral&utm_campaign=artil_connect_launch) and tell us if you get stuck or what's missing.

**If your team has a shared agent** (code reviewer, ops agent) that people message in Slack, we’d love to help you connect it in other channels.

launches.title: Fira MCP: Financial datasets in Claude and Excel
launches.tagline: Connect SEC filings, UK Companies House, market data and earnings transcripts to your AI with source-cited answers
launches.body:
Reliable financial data access and trust in outputs are still the bottleneck in adopting AI in banking, consulting and investment firms. We built Fira MCP to solve that, starting from for teams adopting Claude. Our data connector lets your AI read and cite SEC and international filings, UK Companies House, market data, and earnings transcripts. It works with Claude, Claude for Excel, ChatGPT, and Copilot, while setup takes 3 minutes and it's free to try - <https://firaresearch.com/mcp>.

<https://youtu.be/JoEY1imdVhw>

### Problem

Many banking, consulting, and investment firms are moving day-to-day AI work to Claude. But reliable data access and trust in the outputs are still the bottleneck.

### Solution - Fira MCP

Fira MCP plugs directly into Claude, ChatGPT, Copilot, and Claude for Excel as a data connector. Your AI gets access to filings, transcripts, and market data, with numbers linked back to the exact paragraph or row in the source document. It handles scanned PDFs, nested tables, and works across tens of documents in a single research thread.

## Available datasets

* **SEC Filings** — 8,000+ active US companies (10-K, 10-Q, 8-K, and more)
* **UK Companies House** — 5M+ private companies, including scanned accounts
* **International filings** — 10,000+ companies across 50+ countries
* **Earnings call transcripts** — full transcripts with analyst Q&A
* **Market data** — 20+ years of daily stock and FX, US and global
* **Custom datasets** — proprietary and third-party integrations for enterprise

### Use cases

**I. Peer comparison in Excel** — pull financials, strategy, and risk factors across competitors directly from filings.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=100809&key=user_uploads/626328/99b5fdce-2a4b-4053-a6c1-6b94ec87d578)

**II. Corporate structure mapping** — trace ownership and financials through complex group structures from UK filings.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=100809&key=user_uploads/626328/c1665625-8a07-414d-ac76-b7ecd356b12b)

**III. Earnings call analysis** — review management commentary and analyst Q&A for sentiment and evasive answers.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=100809&key=user_uploads/626328/7fb98502-0b18-4486-b7f7-5b6655161588)

**IV. Document verification** — cross-reference every number against source, catch rounding deltas and inconsistencies.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=100809&key=user_uploads/626328/c11d5c2d-d1d3-4328-a4bb-63dd13aba8d6)

### Asks

Looking to connect with finance professionals (banking, PE, credit, hedge funds, wealth) who want their AI assistant to actually do useful work.

launches.title: Fira: Agentic AI Analyst
launches.tagline: Accelerating financial analysts with source-cited insights and verified calculations from complex company filings
launches.body:
**Fira** is building an agentic AI analyst for financial research and automation, starting with UK investment firms. Today, we accelerate analysts with source-cited insights and verified calculations from complex company filings.

<https://youtu.be/a8C9TifdUOg>

# Problem

Analysts at investment banks and boutique M&A firms waste tons of time digging through hundred-page annual reports to prepare pitch decks and models. General LLM tools aren't good enough for the job — lacking accuracy, domain-specific data, and output verification. The problem extends to senior professionals who need to quickly understand new topics deeply while staying grounded in truthful data sources.

---

# Solution

Fira saves analysts time by instantly searching, analyzing and citing UK company filings. It reads multiple filings and reports (including 500 page long and scanned documents) to provide source-cited answers and verifiable calculations. We cover hundreds of public UK companies, integrate with Companies House for private company data, and allow to upload your documents.

---

# Use cases

**I. Breakdown detailed financial and operational KPIs in seconds**

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=88048&key=user_uploads/626328/d03ed2eb-89ea-49f2-af3e-895cf89dd3a7)

**II. Perform general research on data scattered across reports and filings**

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=88048&key=user_uploads/626328/af63b5d1-c1ba-4551-9168-91c8b3a8ca8f)

**III. Fira calculates financial metrics it can't find, providing transparency in formula and variables used**

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=88048&key=user_uploads/626328/d65b3dba-a6ce-4653-86e9-9ddedcb5d0a4)

# Asks

Looking to connect with senior professionals and analysts at investment banks, M&A advisory firms, hedge funds, and wealth management firms. Especially in the UK. If you work in finance or know someone who does, we'd love an intro. Book a demo [here](https://firaresearch.com) or email us at [alex@firaresearch.com](mailto:alex@firaresearch.com).

# About us

Alexey and Alex are both technical founders, met 9 years ago at university and been close friends since.

Alexey was CTO and co-founder of [resume.io](http://resume.io), one of the largest resume builder websites (acquired in 2021). He’s also an author of wouter, a React router library with 7k stars and 580k downloads/month, and a regular tech conference speaker.

Alex was the founder and CEO of Hashscan, on-chain user analytics startup. Previously, he built a popular crypto porftolio tracker app Hodler (sold in 2022).
